description: Works out a Part 36 offer in England and Wales: when it was made (deemed service, CPR 6.26 and 36.7) and when its relevant period ends; whether an acceptance was in time (CPR 36.13); whether the judgment, or the detailed assessment, beat the offer (CPR 36.17(1)); and the consequences in money: the additional amount, enhanced interest of up to 10% above base rate, indemnity costs and interest on them, the 35% uplift in fixed costs claims (CPR 36.24), or the defendant's costs. Uses the Bank of England's base rate history. Give at least who made the offer, the amount and the date it was sent; add the outcome to see the consequences.

acceptanceAfterCutOff.description: Where accepted: the acceptance was sent at or after 4.30pm.

acceptanceMethod.description: Where accepted: how the acceptance was sent (default email).

acceptanceSent.description: Where accepted: the date the acceptance was sent (YYYY-MM-DD).

awarded.description: Where there was judgment: the damages awarded, excluding interest (in detailed assessment, the bill as assessed), in pounds, e.g. "12500" or "12,500.50".

changedAndBeaten.description: The offer was changed to be less advantageous, and the result beat the changed terms (CPR 36.17(7)(b)).

costsUplift.description: Interest on those costs: percentage points above base rate, up to 10 (default "10").

enhancedBasis.description: Enhanced interest (CPR 36.17(4)(a)): "above-base" (default) or a "fixed" annual rate.

fixedCostsAtExpiry.description: Fixed costs claims: the fixed costs for the stage reached when the relevant period ended, in pounds, e.g. "12500" or "12,500.50".

fixedCostsAtJudgment.description: Fixed costs claims: the fixed costs for the stage reached at judgment, in pounds, e.g. "12500" or "12,500.50".

fixedRate.description: Where enhancedBasis is "fixed": the annual rate in percent.

interestBasis.description: Interest on the damages, for the comparison: "rate" (a simple rate from a date, the default), "figures" (amounts you give) or "none".

interestFrom.description: Where interestBasis is "rate": the date interest runs from (YYYY-MM-DD).

interestRate.description: Where interestBasis is "rate": the annual rate in percent, e.g. "2".

interestToExpiry.description: Where interestBasis is "figures": the interest up to the end of the relevant period, in pounds, e.g. "12500" or "12,500.50".

interestTotal.description: Where interestBasis is "figures": the interest awarded in total, in pounds, e.g. "12500" or "12,500.50".

judgmentDate.description: Where there was judgment: its date (in detailed assessment, the end of the assessment) (YYYY-MM-DD).

offerAfterCutOff.description: The offer was sent at or after 4.30pm (for email, fax, delivery or personal service).

offerAmount.description: The offer, in pounds, e.g. "12500" or "12,500.50".

offerMethod.description: How the offer was sent (default email).

offerSent.description: The date the offer was sent (YYYY-MM-DD).

offeror.description: Who made the offer. In detailed assessment, claimant means the receiving party and defendant the paying party.

outcome.description: "open" (default), "accepted", or "judgment" (in detailed assessment, the end of the assessment).

postExpiryCosts.description: Costs from the end of the relevant period, for interest on costs (CPR 36.17(4)(c)), in pounds, e.g. "12500" or "12,500.50".

proceedings.description: "claim" for a claim outside the fixed costs regimes (default), "fixed-costs" for a claim in Part 45 Sections VI to VIII, or "assessment" for an offer on the bill in detailed assessment (CPR 47.20).

trialDate.description: The trial date, or the detailed assessment hearing date, if one is fixed (YYYY-MM-DD).

uplift.description: Enhanced interest: percentage points above base rate, up to 10 (default "10").

name: calculate_part_36_offer
title: Part 36 calculator (CPR 36.17 consequences)
